author: hollowstrawberry
description: Adds an update command that is more efficient and prettier than the default, although less stable. Cogs that failed to update will be retried next time. Does not reinstall dependecies each time, which fits a fast development environment.
install_msg:
🔃 __**FastUpdate**__
```Cog installed. Run [p]update to update your cogs using this cog.
```
short: Adds an update command that is more efficient and prettier than the default, although less stable.
end_user_data_statement: This cog does not store user data.
